label: r10-fixed

checks.name: Native Android plays distinct protected clips in envelope order, one active track at sampled instants, and clears each cached reply
Local reply expiry stops actual native playback and removes its cached audio despite a stalled network validation; later clips never start
Repeating an expired reply performs no audio request or playback and exposes no false recording-recovery controls
Sequence and expiry checks preserve every care/proposal/turn/route record and upload count without microphone use

environment: Rooted Android 16 ARM64 emulator; actual native media player and cache; local verified TLS proxy, scripted distinct PCM tones; host audio disabled.
